> 3 months ago

Garmin Express v7.29.1 is available for PC today. If you would like to update to the latest version, please visit “About” within the Settings of the Express application and select “Check for Updates to Express.” This version includes the following changes:

 

  • Added support for the CIRQA Smart Band.

 

 Previous Versions:

7.29.0

  • Fixed an incorrect translation for Settings in Traditional Chinese.
  • Resolved an issue with not being able to retrieve purchased content.
  • Resolved an issue with the Queue Pod not displaying updates.
  • Other minor bug fixes and improvements.

7.28.1

  • Addressed an issue with Edge x40 devices stuck in a boot loop state

7.28.0

  • Removed the ability to edit the birthdate in the add device flow.
  • Fixed an issue with the old map image file not being removed for map updates on SD cards.
  • Addressed a crash that could occur when downloading a software update due to bad data being returned.
  • Other minor bug fixes and improvements.

7.27.1

  • Fixed an issue with the Pin Lock banner not displaying.
  • Fixed an issue with devices in Garmin mode not being detected.
  • Fixed an issue with widgets being re-ordered after a sync.

7.27.0

  • Added support for the Rally 110/210
  • Fixed an issue with device software versions displaying
